gates.text: Inherit every [autopilot-full](#autopilot-full) safeguard, including routed ownership, code-ready receipts, independent behavioral verification, fresh-head CI, countersigns, drift checks, custody, and stop propagation.
Replace only its landing and topology rules.
Re-read both at audit boundaries; this route wins on those differences.
Use this route when work is coupled or sequenced, review precedes landing, or merge authority is withheld.
Owners report STACK-READY instead of merge-ready.
Each owner branches from its dependency's branch when coupled and pushes only its own slice.
Owners never rebase onto any branch, including trunk, retarget, merge, close a PR, or arm auto-merge.
Root owns topology; the operator owns landing.
Give topology exactly one writer at the root.
Only that owner rebases or retargets links, appending clean PRs in dependency order with each base set to its parent's branch.
Owners report exact tips and intended parents.
After a root push they explicitly take its SHA as new base and lease.
An owner resolves a conflict in its own slice for root to push; two concurrent topology writers are forbidden.

Until landing starts, root applies autopilot-full's trunk-drift test to each link, rebases bottom-up only where needed, and reapplies [shipping](#shipping)'s patch-id requalification to each patch against its actual parent.
A changed head requires fresh-head CI and the appropriate new-head verifier.
Do not claim carried verdicts without evidence.
Hand back one linear base-chained stack, root and tip, exact heads, dependency order, and a verdict on every link.
Freeze the chain at handoff.
Once landing begins nobody writes except the post-merge move and retarget permitted by [shipping](#shipping).
Mid-landing problems route through root to the operator; any fix waits for the operator's go.
No implicit merge authority.
**Reply.** Stack root and tip pointers, exact heads and one-line verdict per link, STACK-READY state, frozen-chain custody, and parked or excluded items with reasons.

5. At every audit boundary, not only the first resume, re-read both [autopilot-full](#autopilot-full) and this route in full before judging, and note the re-read in the audit record. Refresh any finished owner's record so its phase, delivery state and head match the observed state.
